verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an MCP integration that lets any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) use it as a web search tool, and an official MCP server repo exists at github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp. A community thread independently confirms real-world use of the SerpApi MCP Server and its hosted endpoint at mcp.serpapi.com/mcp with Bearer auth. The one user complaint, about API keys in the URL, was answered by the vendor's existing header-auth support. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup documentation and a description of the exposed tools/engines in the MCP server.
